# AI assistants that may not author, commit or co-author a commit on main
# (maintainer's policy of 2026-11-23). Every identity not matched here passes:
# people, code-quality bots, dependency and release bots, and this repository's
# workflow bots such as autofix@auto-code-scanning.invalid.
#
# One Python regular expression per line, matched case-insensitively with
# re.search against the name and, separately, the address of each author,
# committer and Co-authored-by line. Lines starting with '#' are ignored.
# Read by check.py and the Contributor Identities workflow; see CONTRIBUTING.md.
#
# Names that are also common human names (Jules, Devin, Kiro) match only as a
# whole name or as the assistant's own account, so a person called Jules passes.

# Vendors and assistants, as a whole word in the name or the address
\bclaude\b
\banthropic\b
\bcodex\b
\bopenai\b
\bchatgpt\b
\bcopilot\b
\bcursor\b
\bcursoragent\b
\bgemini\b
\bgrok\b
\bxai\b
\bantigravity\b
\baider\b

# Assistants whose name is also a person's name
^jules$
google-labs-jules
\bjules\[bot\]
^devin$
devin-ai-integration
\bdevin\[bot\]
@devin\.ai$
@cognition\.ai$
^kiro$
\bkiro\[bot\]
@kiro\.dev$

# Model names
\bopus\b
\bsonnet\b
\bhaiku\b
\bfable\b
\bgpt[-_ .]?\d
